name: Transport By Sea 6
definition: Information related for the transportation of goods by sea.

PortOfLoading.name: Port Of Loading
PortOfLoading.definition: Identifies the port where the goods are loaded on board the ship.

PortOfDischarge.name: Port Of Discharge
PortOfDischarge.definition: Identifies the port where the goods are discharged.

SeaCarrierName.name: Sea Carrier Name
SeaCarrierName.definition: Identifies the party that is responsible for the conveyance of the goods from one place to another.

SeaCarrierCountry.name: Sea Carrier Country
SeaCarrierCountry.definition: Country in which the carrier of the goods, for example, shipping company, is located or registered.

CarrierAgentName.name: Carrier Agent Name
CarrierAgentName.definition: Name of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.

CarrierAgentCountry.name: Carrier Agent Country
CarrierAgentCountry.definition: Country of registration of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.
